extracted.name: Gravy Baked Pork Chops
extracted.description: This baked and smothered pork chop recipe uses simple pantry ingredients and condensed cream of mushroom soup with incredibly delicious results.
ingredient_lines: 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat; add pork chops and sauté for about 5 minutes per side.
Combine milk, water, and condensed soup in a separate medium bowl.
Arrange pork chops in a 9x13-inch baking dish; pour soup mixture over chops.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 145 degrees F (63 degrees C).
